STEP_2_THE_PINNED_POLICY.restart_treatment: durable original timing. The deadline is in the record, so a manager restart re-reads it and neither resets nor revives it; the worker's own receipt fence independently prevents a second provider turn.
STEP_2_THE_PINNED_POLICY.LIM_classification: LIM-2, a TOKEN bound. It is derived per attempt from that attempt's own enumerated operation bounds, and each attempt acquires its own token, so nothing accumulates across the Job's two stages. It is NOT the LIM-3 cumulative limit the pilot declined, and it is not an invocation-count policy: the counts above are the product's own enforced invariants, not selections I made.
